mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `order` (source_type, source_id, buyer_id, seller_id, work_id, deposit, final_amount, total_amount, order_status) VALUES (#{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{buyerId}, #{sellerId}, #{workId}, #{deposit}, #{finalAmount}, #{totalAmount}, #{orderStatus})
mapper.select: SELECT o.*, b_prof.nickname AS buyerName, s_prof.nickname AS sellerName, w.title AS workTitle FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN user_profile b_prof ON o.buyer_id = b_prof.account_id LEFT JOIN user_profile s_prof ON o.seller_id = s_prof.account_id LEFT JOIN work w ON o.work_id = w.id WHERE o.id = #{id}

SELECT o.*, b_prof.nickname AS buyerName, s_prof.nickname AS sellerName, w.title AS workTitle FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN user_profile b_prof ON o.buyer_id = b_prof.account_id LEFT JOIN user_profile s_prof ON o.seller_id = s_prof.account_id LEFT JOIN work w ON o.work_id = w.id WHERE o.buyer_id = #{buyerId} AND o.buyer_deleted = 0 ORDER BY o.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `order` WHERE buyer_id = #{buyerId} AND buyer_deleted = 0

SELECT o.*, b_prof.nickname AS buyerName, s_prof.nickname AS sellerName, w.title AS workTitle FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN user_profile b_prof ON o.buyer_id = b_prof.account_id LEFT JOIN user_profile s_prof ON o.seller_id = s_prof.account_id LEFT JOIN work w ON o.work_id = w.id WHERE o.seller_id = #{sellerId} AND o.seller_deleted = 0 ORDER BY o.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `order` WHERE seller_id = #{sellerId} AND seller_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE `order` SET order_status = #{orderStatus}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE `order` SET buyer_deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND buyer_id = #{buyerId}
UPDATE `order` SET seller_deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND seller_id = #{sellerId}
mapper.select: SELECT o.*, b_prof.nickname AS buyerName, s_prof.nickname AS sellerName, w.title AS workTitle FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN user_profile b_prof ON o.buyer_id = b_prof.account_id LEFT JOIN user_profile s_prof ON o.seller_id = s_prof.account_id LEFT JOIN work w ON o.work_id = w.id ORDER BY o.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT * FROM `order` WHERE order_status = #{status} AND create_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `order` WHERE source_type = #{sourceType} AND source_id = #{sourceId}
